cases.root_cause: Six consecutive option_snapshots runs (10:00–10:25 ET) failed each with a bare TimeoutError() after only ~4 s — the connect to the Gateway's API port timed out, twice in a row (10:00–10:15 and 10:20–10:25), so ~30 min of option snapshots were lost (permanently: option quotes can't be backfilled). Only the option collector failed; index_snapshots and equity_bars kept succeeding, and no farm codes (2103/2105/2157) or gateway/connection errors (1100/1102) appear in the runs, and SLI3 bar completeness is still 100%.

Unknown from the available data. The four index_snapshots slots at 13:00–13:15 ET on 2026-11-12 all failed after exactly 120 s (the index execution timeout) and the 13:20 slot succeeded, so the Gateway was unresponsive for about 20 minutes and then recovered by itself — but the recorded 'error' field contains no IBKR code or exception, only an injected instruction-like string, so the actual failure mode (connect timeout vs. non-answering request, farm drop, etc.) cannot be determined from pipeline_runs. Note: option_snapshots had no failed runs that day and all SLIs are met, which argues against a session-wide Gateway outage like 2026-10-26.

IBKR's SPX market-data farm dropped for ~30 minutes (13:00–13:30 ET): every option-snapshot run in that window failed after 25 s with "SPX: no spot price" and farm codes 2103/2105, after the collector's own RECONNECTDATA attempt. The episode cleared on its own at 13:35 — the Gateway was up the whole time (index snapshots succeeded through the same window), so no restart or manual reconnect is needed.

Six consecutive option_snapshots runs (slots 11:00–11:25 ET) failed with no error recorded, each surviving exactly 480 s — the 8-minute option execution timeout — so each was killed by the run-budget/execution timeout rather than raising a request error. The Gateway itself was healthy: index_snapshots had 0 failures on 2026-11-12 and option runs resumed normal 244–288 s durations after the block, and no farm-disconnect codes (1100/2103/2105/2157) or subscription codes appear in these runs. The data does not show why each run overran the 8-min budget (no chain_errors / "run budget used up" or per-chain detail was returned for the failed runs), so the specific trigger is not established from the tool results.

Alpaca's API returned HTTP 503 Service Unavailable to every equity-bar run from 12:00 ET onward, so equity bars stopped being collected at the source; IBKR collection on the same host was unaffected. This is a vendor-side outage, not a Gateway, host or pipeline problem — the eod refetch (10 sessions) is the recovery path for the missing bars.
